generation_notes: Revised to exactly 4 distinct MODBUS/TCP seed sequences using supplied plans as primary guidance and conservative Modbus/TCP framing priors only for gaps. All messages use a 7-byte MBAP header, protocol identifier 0x0000, and internally consistent MBAP Length fields. Historical issue evidence is retained only as structural guidance for safe analogues; exact reproduced crash payloads and malformed length collisions were removed. Diversity was improved across operations and sequence shapes by keeping one issue-guided Read Input Registers request, one single-step Report Server ID request, one two-step Report Server ID stateful exchange, and one additional valid function-code coverage seed for Read File Record to broaden parser and field-layout coverage without cosmetic duplication.
coverage_summary: MBAP header coverage with 7-byte header and protocol identifier 0x0000
Read Input Registers function code 0x04 with address/quantity request fields
Report Server ID function code 0x11 as single-request analogue
Report Server ID function code 0x11 in a two-message stateful request/response exchange
Read File Record function code 0x14 with subrequest byte-count structure
Single-request and multi-step stateful sequence shapes
Variation in unit identifiers, transaction identifiers, and PDU layouts
Safe structural analogues derived from issue reports 738, 614, 764, 803, and 810 without reusing exact historical crash payloads

sequences.expected_behavior: Server should parse a valid Read Input Registers request and return either normal register data or a protocol-level exception, without instability.

Protocol identifier set to 0x0000
MBAP length 0x0006 matches unit identifier plus 5-byte PDU
Function code 0x04 is documented for Read Input Registers

sequences.issue_safety_notes: Uses the issue-referenced read-input-registers shape but changes the concrete address and quantity away from the reported trigger; no malformed response shaping or exact crash payload reuse.

sequences.title: Stateful Report Server ID request and response exchange

sequences.expected_behavior: Client should correlate the response to the request by transaction and unit identifier and process a normal Report Server ID style payload without desynchronization.
constraints_preserved: 7-byte MBAP header preserved in both messages

sequences.issue_safety_notes: This is a safe stateful analogue for length-handling concerns: both frames have internally consistent MBAP lengths and avoid the incorrect-length forms cited in historical reports.
